title: Sunset Lake, Asbury Park (NYPL b11707648-G90F454 063F)
blurb: * Includes views by G.W. Pach, W.H. Hill, W. H. Stauffer and other photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Views of Asbury Park and Ocean Grove, N.J., including sailboats and ships, boating on Wesley and Sunset Lakes, bridges and islands, people bathing, promenading and gathered for religious services, the post office, homes, hotels, tents, educational hall, tabernacle, bath houses, a well, coaches, a restaurant, and group portraits.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.18% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured deep (3.98% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at 67% size.
